For the Petitioner : M/s. Gautam Kumar, Advocate For the State : M/s. Kumari Rashmi, A.P.P For
the O.P. No. 2 : M/s. Avishek Prasad, Advocate
---
05/12.06.2024 Heard the Parties.

Petitioner is apprehending his arrest in connection with Namkum P.S. Case No. 186/2023,
registered under Sections 406/ 420/ 120b of the Indian Penal Code, pending in the Court of Miss
Anamika Kisku, learned J.M.Xii, Ranchi.
It appears that the petitioner had entered into an agreement for sale of land with the informant for which Rs. 8,80,000/- were credited in his account and subsequently the sale deed was not executed.
It was submitted that the dispute between the parties has been settled and the petitioner had already paid rupees one lakh to the informant and the remaining amount has to be paid by December 2024.
Regard being had to the facts and circumstance of the case; I am inclined to extend the privilege of Anticipatory Bail to the petitioner provisionally till 30.08.2024.

He is directed to surrender before the court below within two weeks from the date of receipt of copy of this order and learned court below on his surrender shall release him on provisional bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs. 25,000/-
(Twenty five Thousand only) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of Miss Anamika Kisku, learned J.M.XII, Ranchi or her successor in connection with Namkum P.S. Case No.
186/2023, Subject to the conditions as laid down under Section 438 (2) Cr.P.C.
